description:
Hi,

I hope you are doing good.

I have a job opportunity related to your profile with one of our client, please find below Job Description for your review. If you are interested and available for the following position then please send your updated resume in word format along with your contact details to discuss further.

 Role: Strong CoreJava Developer
Duration: Full TIme / Permanent
Location: Tampa FL
 
 Job Description: 
 Strong hands-on experience in Core Java / J2EE 
 Core Java, OOPS f undamentals and advanced concepts
 Java collections
 Multithreading (Advanced thread concepts) / Synchronization / Executor Frameworks / Concurrency frameworks.
 Design Patterns (To be able to justify usage of advanced design patterns in projects worked) – multiple patterns like façade, composite, builder on top of basics like factory, singleton, MVC etc.
 Spring (Core, Aspects, and MVC etc.)
 Struts 
 Hibernate (transaction management, JPA/JTA concepts)
 Strong JMS knowledge (messaging)


 Strong knowledge and experience with Databases 
 DB Joins
 Constraints / Primary and Referential Integrity
 Performance tuning techniques (explain_plan, Indexes, Partitions)
 Views / Materialized Views.
 Implicit/Explicit cursors

 Strong knowledge of Unix Shell Scripting 
 
Nice to Have Skills/criteria

 Javascript Frameworks like ExtJs/AngularJS
 IBM MQ 


 • Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education.


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
